SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Move_Kind = 'SHFT' THEN Unit_Nbr END) AS SHFT_Moves_Count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Move_Kind = 'YARD' THEN Unit_Nbr END) AS YARD_Moves_Count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Move_Kind = 'LOAD' THEN Unit_Nbr END) AS LOAD_Moves_Count,
    Week,
    Month,
    Year
FROM
    moves
WHERE
    Month >= 9
    AND Category_Id = 'EXPRT'
    AND Year = 2026
    AND Move_Kind IN ('SHFT', 'YARD', 'LOAD')
GROUP BY
    Week,
    Month,
    Year
ORDER BY
    Year,
    Month,
    Week;
